reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 21. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 39 (98%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
This week in the 10th and in Washington…

🪻 The New Jersey delegation came together to connect and discuss shared priorities for NJ
🎖️ The House passed my bill to support veteran entrepreneurs
🪖 Team LaMonica attended Veterans Day events honoring our local veterans https://t.co/tyPA9AMRKa

Team LaMonica spent time honoring and celebrating our veterans this past week in NJ-10. We're grateful for the opportunity to honor and recognize the courage, service, and sacrifice of New Jersey veterans. Swipe to see our brave veterans! https://t.co/4B1nsNbgZh

For far too long, women have had their symptoms dismissed or their needs overlooked in research and our doctors’ offices. I will continue addressing these issues and fighting for greater investments in women’s healthcare. Every woman deserves great care, attention, and treatment.

https://t.co/UGRfI9nndC

My team and I are closely monitoring the FAA ground stop at EWR and nationwide, and will continue to share information as it becomes available. While we hope flight operations return to normal as soon as possible, passenger safety must remain the top priority. https://t.co/KvDkwOLvOb

Verona, my team is here to help! 

Stop by the Council Chambers in Verona Town Hall from 11am-2pm today for help with resources, questions, and help navigating the services available to you. https://t.co/btiLL9XAml

Republicans don't have my constituents' best interests at heart, and Americans voted them out for a reason. They can either get on board and get to work for the American people or they can go kick rocks. https://t.co/gHMxRUI5ap
It’s never been about just me. My case is about how we hold Trump, Miller, Blanche, and ICE accountable. https://t.co/whvcNutHe2

A veteran died in East Orange while the VA's operating room was closed because of Trump's cuts. 

Billions spent funding Trump's war of choice while the VA gets stripped. Trump claims he “loves veterans,” then treats them like they’re expendable. Disgraceful. https://t.co/uWGqb6Gb3d

My bill dedicated to supporting and developing Veteran entrepreneurs PASSED the House today, on Veterans Day!

Veterans are essential to our communities, and their work deserves our support. My bill would make sure veterans get the support they need. https://t.co/XDTYdPA0pZ

On Veterans Day and every day, we must ensure veterans and their families receive the care, benefits, and opportunities they’ve earned. I’ll keep working for veterans, including with my bill supporting Veteran-Owned small businesses that is on the House floor today! 🎖️ https://t.co/0YXJ8PWxAY

Grateful that everyone aboard the United flight from Newark landed safely after today’s incident. I commend the entire flight crew for taking action quickly and professionally. My office remains in contact with the airline and EWR to get more information on what transpired. https://t.co/0WLluWweES

With Stephen Miller at the helm, I expect even more brutal detention tactics. And with Trump’s DOJ, congressional oversight is needed now more than ever. I am facing 17 years in prison for doing my job, and I won’t be the last. But they can’t scare us, we’ll keep showing up. https://t.co/OgqCJmfFtw

I’ll protect NJ-10 and the people who count on me, over and over again. The admin is trying to put me in prison for 17 years for standing up to ICE—it’s painful to see this happen and hard to go through, but it will not stop me from protecting my community. https://t.co/jH2pkoJmQe

This American Diabetes Month, we recognize everyone impacted by diabetes and remember the importance of early detection, prevention, research, and affordable care. Everyone deserves the healthcare they need. https://t.co/fhgFiROAwJ

Baby and I are on our way back to D.C. to vote in Congress! This place wasn’t built for young moms, but we will not stop defying expectations and working to make things better. This will be a journey, but I'm committed to serving NJ-10 and being the best mom I can be.💜 https://t.co/kKrOL8cUUj

Just a few days left, NJ-10 high school students! Don’t miss out on applications for Service Academy Nominations. If you’re interested in attending a U.S. Service Academy, you can request a nomination through my office. https://t.co/lnDdHqQTsp

I’m always proud to defend my LGBTQ+ constituents. In a moment when our neighbors and friends are under attack, I will always stand for their dignity, humanity, and rights. 

Thank you @HRC for all you do. https://t.co/pdBF596s7r

topics.topic: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

posts.text:
Stephen Miller is a white supremacist. 

Promoting the guy responsible for ICE detaining our neighbors and killing people in the streets is Trump doubling down on cruelty and corruption. The administration is falling apart, and Trump is panicking, as he should be. https://t.co/l1Tbm7nCnJ
One thing about tables, they turn. https://t.co/bGiBcuBFKw

Cranford, we can’t wait to see you!

Stop by Cranford Community Center from 11am-2pm today for help with resources, questions, and help navigating the services available to you. https://t.co/rSAf6VLKi1

Donald Trump put his donors and cronies above what our families needed. Billionaires got richer, and it got harder for everyone else to put food on the table. Democrats have a mandate, and I’ve got my to-do list: make stuff cost less and hold the bigots and bullies who got us
Today is Election Day, NJ-10. Go to https://t.co/oGV98eaGy4 for more information on a polling location near you. Go Vote! 🗳️ 🇺🇸
NJ-10, November mobile office hours are here! Come join us in your community this month. Team LaMonica is here to help you! https://t.co/hnnVyiuOTv

Election Day is tomorrow, and only you can voice your opinion at the ballot box. So many have fought and sacrificed for the democracy we have today—and for our right to vote. 

Don’t underestimate your voice. Go vote. https://t.co/7ZynPSm1o5

Praying for Senator Murphy’s health. He’s been such a kind voice and a friend in hard times. Wishing him a quick recovery. 💜

https://t.co/kKeEVMpAle https://t.co/MaTZfci2H9
NJ-10, it’s time to get covered. Open enrollment under the Affordable Care Act is now open. We are here to help if you need us. https://t.co/m5cCM7kWxt

This week in the 10th, Team LaMonica was…
🎃 Hosting Halloween office hours and bingo at Kenilworth Senior Center!
📢 Supporting a Know Your Rights workshop in Montclair
🎖️Learning more about the NJ Youth ChalleNGe Academy in Sea Girt https://t.co/6tGz7MxOcz
Happy Halloween, NJ-10. Stay safe and enjoy a fun night with family and friends! 🍬👻🎃 https://t.co/IOh7k0ZihY

Today, my office will hold mobile office hours at Kenilworth Senior Center!

Stop by for help with casework, navigating federal agencies, or questions about services available to you.

Come see us! Team LaMonica can’t wait to help you! https://t.co/wOal2XO6xQ

Dolores Huerta set a standard for change in this country, inspiring thousands to fight for better.

Today I celebrate her work, bravery, and tireless advocacy. We must carry on her legacy and keep the work moving forward. May she rest 🕊️

https://t.co/14Im3hymfx
Serving NJ-10... it’s a calling. https://t.co/gx8uOF7YVH

Regardless of the charges I'm facing, I will never abandon NJ-10. That means continuing to do oversight of ICE  facilities.

It is our job, as your representatives, to prevent these facilities from operating in the shadows. It's not a responsibility that I take lightly.
Sometimes fighting for the place you grew up in is all you need. 💜 https://t.co/cwWhOy6PK0

This week in the 10th, Team LaMonica was…
🍽️ Serving meals at Newark’s Senior Meeting 
⚖️ Welcoming a new cohort of Congressional Youth Advisory Council scholars!
🏡 Celebrating the groundbreaking of new housing in Jersey City https://t.co/R9pPtVGFPf

Our best album yet. 🍁

Happy Fall, y’all! Fall can be one of the best times in NJ-10.

What’s your favorite fall activity? https://t.co/WUz2b5Yydr

NJ-10 high school students, don’t miss out on applications for Service Academy Nominations! If you’re interested in attending a U.S. Service Academy, you can request a nomination through my office. Make sure to complete and submit your application by Wednesday, November 11th! https://t.co/X4HWE1TtJT

I’m proud to join a small group of women who have given birth while serving in Congress. It’s pretty clear that this place wasn’t built for young moms, but we’re making it work because we have to. We’re dedicated to service, community, and our families.
https://t.co/QoSxWe2KAx

This Breast Cancer Awareness Month, we honor survivors, remember those we’ve lost, and stand with everyone impacted by breast cancer. 💗 

I’ll keep supporting early detection, pushing for strong research funding, and working toward a healthier future for all.

East Orange, get ready! Today, my office will hold mobile office hours at the Bowser Family Senior Center.

Stop by for help with casework, navigating federal agencies, or questions about services available to you. https://t.co/a6J4uEzgcm

This week in the 10th, Team LaMonica was….
🩺 Honoring healthcare workers at CareWell Health Medical Center’s 100 Anniversary Block Party
📢 Supporting advocates at the Statewide Black Agenda Rally
💜 Recognizing Mary’s Closet new clothing resource for domestic violence victims https://t.co/EjMM1zuuji

My family has been over the moon since we welcomed our new baby girl.

https://t.co/xbFag7DEWA
https://t.co/xioQZP3sqh
Apply to the Congressional App Challenge today! https://t.co/3DtzXqplw0

Heartbroken to hear about the shooting in Bend. I am praying for the families, students, teachers and community members of Silver Rail Elementary. No community should have to go through this. Our children deserve better. https://t.co/N33IOi0ybn
https://t.co/TzTZFZzXey

It’s almost time to vote, New Jersey! Early voting runs from October 24th - November 1st, and it’s important to make a plan to vote.  

Check out this guide for everything you need to know to cast your vote and make your voice heard! https://t.co/tr0DQME9sP

Apply here: 
https://t.co/GZprcVfKbu

Attention NJ-10 high school students! Applications are open for Service Academy Nominations. If you’re interested in attending a U.S. Service Academy, you can request a nomination through my office. Make sure to complete and submit your application by Wednesday, November 11th! https://t.co/1BeGuu2nS8

My dear friend Eddie Osborne was a true public servant in Newark and beyond. He devoted his life to serving others through his work in labor rights, public housing, the ABC Commission, and so much more.

His legacy of service, leadership, and friendship will not be forgotten. https://t.co/844pvrymuA

I know what being targeted feels like all too well, and it's wrong that my friend @Ilhan is going through it again. Black women in Congress are being ruthlessly targeted for doing our jobs and standing up to Trump. https://t.co/eFWGkpjmux
Apply today: https://t.co/Nc9fz6Qii8

Want to get your start in public service? Team LaMonica is looking for interns in Newark and DC! The deadline to apply for the spring 2027 session is October 20. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. https://t.co/svUnJ2vkoy

Trump uses @DHSgov and @TheJusticeDept as weapons to go after the people standing up to him. Raiding @Ilhan’s home weeks before Election Day is the kind of overreach that should scare every single American. 

I stand with Ilhan. We will never be intimidated into silence. https://t.co/Ob25ZV91sr

This Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor the generations of Indigenous peoples who have shaped our nation through their cultures, traditions, leadership, and contributions. Let’s continue to recognize their voices, preserve their histories, and support these communities.

This week in the 10th, Team LaMonica was….
🎖️ Supporting the next generation of leaders at our U.S. Service Academy Day
🎉 Celebrating GlassRoots’ 25 years of creativity and learning for students in Newark
🤝 Hosting office hours at Hillside Senior Center and South End Gardens https://t.co/V667OXyvQ1

The charges Trump's DOJ brought against me are baseless and dangerous—not just to me, but to anyone who dares to speak out against this admin’s lies. I’m in Congress to serve my district and home. I will not be intimidated out of doing the work my constituents trusted me to do.
https://t.co/ixMuYfG9Lk

Hey NJ-10, Election Day is coming up and voter registration ends soon! 

Check your voter registration, learn about important deadlines, and find voting information at your state or local election office.

Your voice matters. Go to https://t.co/8ESuMwhF8I https://t.co/K6jJIlvWHD

My statement on my decision to move forward with an en banc hearing for my case. Oversight is my job, and I will fight like hell to protect it. I will not fold to this administration. https://t.co/pJr9LJQ6VM
If you have more questions, reach out to us at https://t.co/zzlbPmnxvD for help.

Thank you to everyone who joined the team for Service Academy Day! It was great to welcome NJ-10 students and families, and connect them with representatives from all five U.S. service academies.

We’re proud to support the next generation of leaders! https://t.co/A1WgoxEBKc

Former Senate President Pro Tempore Sandra Cunningham was a true leader, public servant, and voice for the people of New Jersey. She will be sincerely missed. 🕊️

https://t.co/NP5ACcfREE

If you can't get in the door to do oversight, how are we going to get the truth about what is happening at ICE facilities like Delaney Hall? The truth is the administration wants it this way. They want us in the dark. https://t.co/EGJWlvZyy4

I’m so happy Martin Soto has been reunited with his family. His wife, Gabriela fought for this—when we visited Delaney and Elizabeth to check on Martin she was always there, fighting. No one should endure what the Sotos experienced at the hands of ICE. As we celebrate Martin’s freedom, the fight to shut down Delaney and abolish ICE continues.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
